select vo.ORDER_ID as orderId, /** 指令编号 **/ d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, /**业务类型**/ cp.FINPROD_ID as prodId, /**投资主体代码**/ cp.FINPROD_ABBR as prodAbbr, /**投资主体名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, /**资产简称**/ vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderTypeCode, /** 指令类型Code **/ vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderType, /** 指令类型 **/ DATE_FORMAT(vo.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as settleDate, /** 结算日期 **/ IFNULL(tdf.FEE_AMT,'0') as tdFeeAmt, /**通道费**/ vo.SETTLE_AMT as settleAmt, /** 结算金额 **/ vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatusCode, /** 结算状态Code **/ vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatus /** 结算状态 **/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d left join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join ( SELECT
trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ) e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id left join
( SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18' ) cp
on cp.finprod_id = '不进行关联' inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id /*关联结算指令表时，一定要关联结算指令扩展表，加上关联条件是否随交易出账='N'的条件 2018-12-17 王耕耘与褚密分析结果*/ inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and vo.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} order by vo.SETTLE_DATE ASC

select vo.ORDER_ID as orderId, /** 指令编号 **/ d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, /**业务类型**/ cp.FINPROD_ID as prodId, /**投资主体代码**/ cp.FINPROD_ABBR as prodAbbr, /**投资主体名称**/ zc.finprod_id as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.finprod_abbr as assetAbbr, /**资产简称**/ vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderTypeCode, /** 指令类型Code **/ vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderType, /** 指令类型 **/ DATE_FORMAT(vo.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as settleDate, /** 结算日期 **/ IFNULL(tdf.FEE_AMT,'0') as tdFeeAmt, /**通道费**/ vo.SETTLE_AMT as settleAmt, /** 结算金额 **/ vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatusCode, /** 结算状态Code **/ vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatus /** 结算状态 **/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d left join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and zc.finprod_type = d.finprod_type left join ( SELECT
trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ) e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id left join
( SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18' ) cp
on cp.finprod_id = '不进行关联' inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id /*关联结算指令表时，一定要关联结算指令扩展表，加上关联条件是否随交易出账='N'的条件 2018-12-17 王耕耘与褚密分析结果*/ inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and vo.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} order by vo.SETTLE_DATE ASC

SELECT a.orderId, a.tradeId, a.busiTypeCode, a.busiType, a.prodId, a.prodAbbr, a.feeType, a.orderTypeCode, a.orderType, a.settleDate, a.settleStatusCode, a.settleStatus, a.finprodtype, sum(a.settleAmt) settleAmt from (select vo.ORDER_ID as orderId, /** 指令编号 **/ d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, /**业务类型**/ zc.FINPROD_ID as prodId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR as prodAbbr, /**资产简称**/ tdf.fee_type feeType, /**费用类型**/ vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderTypeCode, /** 指令类型Code **/ vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderType, /** 指令类型 **/ DATE_FORMAT(vo.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as settleDate, /** 结算日期 **/ IFNULL(tdf.FEE_AMT,'0') as settleAmt, /**结算金额**/ vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatusCode, /** 结算状态Code **/ vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatus, /** 结算状态 **/ tdf.fee_type finprodtype from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT
trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ) e ON d.TRADE_ID=e.TRADE_ID left join
( SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18' )
zc on zc.finprod_id = '不进行关联'
left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on d.trade_id = tdf.trade_id inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id /*关联结算指令表时，一定要关联结算指令扩展表，加上关联条件是否随交易出账='N'的条件 2018-12-17 王耕耘与褚密分析结果*/ inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and vo.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} and d.finprod_type = 'C07'
and tdf.fee_type in
#{feeType}
order by vo.SETTLE_DATE ASC) a group by a.orderId, a.tradeId, a.busiTypeCode, a.busiType, a.prodId, a.prodAbbr, a.orderTypeCode, a.orderType, a.settleDate, a.feeType, a.settleStatusCode, a.settleStatus, a.finprodtype
